question: How many lost-link events per year does the FAA record for the Autel EVO Max 4N?

intake.focus: FAA lost-link events per year Autel EVO Max 4N
intake.reason: Question asks for FAA-recorded lost-link statistics for the Autel EVO Max 4N. Our collection includes guidance and reports (FAA AC 107-2A, AAIB, NASA ASRS, community accounts) but does not provide FAA annual counts. We can summarize guidance on lost-link behavior, but exact yearly FAA statistics are not available here.

brief.short_answer: FAA guidance: AC 107-2A says to reestablish the control link and, if unsuccessful, initiate emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link. Manuals: No usable evidence found in the approved Autel EVO Max 4N manual collection. Incident reports (unverified): claims include loss of control shortly after takeoff, failed Return To Home attempts, and that the UAS platform has not been located or recovered. Gaps: open questions about the annual count of lost-link events for Autel EVO Max 4N; no verified official count is provided, and the reliability of these unverified accounts is unclear.
